AppRole.description: Application role label. ArmorIQ policy, not this label, authorizes tools.
AppRole.title: AppRole

ApprovalState.description:
HOLD lifecycle state.

`pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` mirror statuses the pinned SDK
reports for a delegation. `timeout`, `interrupted`, `unverified` are
application states (never treated as approval).
ApprovalState.title: ApprovalState

ApprovalStatus.description:
State of a real ArmorIQ HOLD for one plan step.

`delegation_id` may be absent briefly: the SDK reports the hold before the
delegation request exists. UNRESOLVED: whether approver identity is
observable through the pinned SDK.
ApprovalStatus.title: ApprovalStatus

ArmorIQDecision.description:
Authorization result for one planned step, labeled by the layer that decided.

Mapped from real ArmorIQ SDK responses/exceptions by the backend gateway.
`enforcement_action` keeps ArmorIQ's raw value (e.g. "allow_log") verbatim.
ArmorIQDecision.title: ArmorIQDecision

AuditEvent.description: Append-only audit event. `payload` must already be redacted (no secrets/tokens).
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

AuditEventType.description: Provisional audit event types (PRD v2 §7 step 14). Extend in Phase 2.
AuditEventType.title: AuditEventType

AuthenticatedUser.description:
A requester resolved by trusted backend code (PRD v2 §4.1).

Deliberately excludes the raw ArmorIQ member email: it stays inside the
backend (masked in UI/logs). Identity is never taken from chat text.

masked_email.description: e.g. m***@example.com; never the raw address
masked_email.title: Masked Email

AuthenticatedUser.title: AuthenticatedUser

CitationView.description:
A validated citation of the delivered answer (source ID + tier persisted;
the title only from the owner's web inbox).
CitationView.title: CitationView

ConfirmationOfferView.description:
A pending D-14 confirmation for the owner's confirm control.

``token`` is the single-use value the web confirm button posts back as
``confirmation_token``; it is shown only to the requesting member's
session, only until it expires, and is never logged or audited.
ConfirmationOfferView.title: ConfirmationOfferView

CreateRequestBody.description: Web request body. No identity, tier, or recipient field exists (R-10).
CreateRequestBody.title: CreateRequestBody

CreateRequestResponse.description: ``202`` body: the orchestrator-minted request ID (``req-<32 hex>``).
CreateRequestResponse.title: CreateRequestResponse

DataTier.description: Knowledge sensitivity tiers (PRD v2 §5.1). Encoded in tool names, never in arguments.
DataTier.title: DataTier

DecisionOutcome.description: Authorization outcome for one planned tool call.
DecisionOutcome.title: DecisionOutcome

DecisionSource.description:
Which layer produced a decision.

Union of the labels in PRD v2 §10.1 and Architecture v2.1 §5.3 (see ADR-009).
Never label an SDK client-side mismatch as a hosted-proxy decision.
DecisionSource.title: DecisionSource

DeliveryChannel.description: Where an answer was delivered (Architecture v2.1 §7.2).
DeliveryChannel.title: DeliveryChannel

ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx JSON response from ProxyLead services uses this envelope.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

KnowledgeSearchHit.description: UNRESOLVED: snippet length limit and score scale (depends on E17 / RRF design).
KnowledgeSearchHit.title: KnowledgeSearchHit

KnowledgeSearchResult.description: Output of a `knowledge_search_*` tool. `tier` is set by the server from the tool name.
KnowledgeSearchResult.title: KnowledgeSearchResult

ManagerConnectorStatus.description:
One connector tile of ``GET /api/v1/manager/health``.

``status`` is the machine value; ``label`` is the exact wording the
console shows (P4-04 §9.6). ``planned`` is never a fake health result:
it marks a connector that does not exist yet (Gmail, Drive, Meet).
ManagerConnectorStatus.title: ManagerConnectorStatus

ManagerHealthView.description:
``GET /api/v1/manager/health``: real checks, one row per connector.

Every ``connected`` / ``unavailable`` verdict comes from a live probe
(tool-server ``/health``, a backend ``SELECT 1``, the Slack socket
thread); an unconfigured or failed probe reports ``unavailable``, never
a fake ``connected``.
ManagerHealthView.title: ManagerHealthView

ManagerHoldView.description:
One unresolved HOLD of ``GET /api/v1/manager/holds``.

``armoriq_console_url`` is the D-22 target where Maya resolves it;
``note`` repeats that approval happens only there. There is no approve
or reject field by design (R-40, Arch §5.6).
ManagerHoldView.title: ManagerHoldView

ManagerRequestSummary.description:
One row of ``GET /api/v1/manager/requests`` (newest first).

Mirrors the P3-01 ``RequestSummary``; only IDs that have a
``request_received`` event are listed. Identity fields are empty when
the stored origin payload is unreadable.
ManagerRequestSummary.title: ManagerRequestSummary

ManagerTimelineEntry.description:
One event of ``GET /api/v1/manager/requests/{request_id}/timeline``.

Merged request / decision / delivery events, oldest first, with the
console's correlation fields: ``jti`` and ``ledger_entry_id`` line up
with the execution ledger (SHARED_INTERFACES §13). Every optional field
is a whitelisted extraction from the reader's redacted payload; missing
or unknown values stay ``None`` rather than failing the page.
ManagerTimelineEntry.title: ManagerTimelineEntry

ManagerTopicRuleUpdate.description:
``PUT /api/v1/manager/topic-rules`` body: topic + ceiling only.

A request body, so it can never carry identity or authority: unknown
keys (``member_id``, ``app_role``, ``actor``, ...) are refused with a
``422`` envelope. ``topic`` validity is enforced by
``apps.api.topic_map.validate_topic`` (normalization, length,
specificity), mapped to the same ``422``; the stored
``created_by_member_id`` always comes from the session.
ManagerTopicRuleUpdate.title: ManagerTopicRuleUpdate

ManagerTopicRuleView.description: One topic-map rule (P3-02): retrieval configuration, not authority.
ManagerTopicRuleView.title: ManagerTopicRuleView

ManagerTopicRulesView.description: ``GET /api/v1/manager/topic-rules``: the rules plus the access note.
ManagerTopicRulesView.title: ManagerTopicRulesView

ManagerUnansweredView.description:
One queue row of ``GET /api/v1/manager/unanswered``.

The question is stored redacted at write time and passed through
unchanged; no protected snippet is ever part of this view.
ManagerUnansweredView.title: ManagerUnansweredView

McpEndpoint.description: Registered MCP endpoint names (PRD v2 §2). Must match the ArmorIQ console exactly.
McpEndpoint.title: McpEndpoint

OffPlanAttemptView.description:
A model-requested tool call routed off-plan (P3-03/P3-07). Never executed.

``enforcement_layer`` is the server's wording for ``decision_source``;
``is_armoriq_policy`` is true only for ArmorIQ policy sources (ADR-026),
never for the client-side SDK plan check or application rules.
OffPlanAttemptView.title: OffPlanAttemptView

PersonaKey.description: Fictional demo members (PRD v2 §1). Labels only — never identity proof.
PersonaKey.title: PersonaKey

PlanProposal.description:
Planner output, built from the user's message only (PRD v2 §7).

UNRESOLVED (Phase 2): maximum step count, an `intent` field, and a
clarifying-question field. Only the PRD's elevated-tier rule is enforced.
PlanProposal.title: PlanProposal

PlannedToolCall.description:
One validated step of a plan. Tier is implied by `tool`, never an argument.

UNRESOLVED (Phase 2): per-tool argument schemas. Until they exist,
`arguments` is a JSON object screened for forbidden/underscore keys.
PlannedToolCall.title: PlannedToolCall

RequestContext.description: Trusted context created by the backend for every inbound request.
RequestContext.title: RequestContext

RequestStatusView.description: Owner-only status of one request (P4-01, polled by P4-02/P4-03).

egress_sink_executions.description: Executed send_external_message steps of this request, counted from the persisted ledger-backed execution references (the only way the honeypot writes its synthetic sink). Guarded mode: always 0. The backend cannot read the sink table itself (grant PROPOSED, SHARED_INTERFACES §7).
egress_sink_executions.title: Egress Sink Executions

RequestStatusView.title: RequestStatusView

ReviewStatus.description: Knowledge authority (PRD v2 §8.4). Supersession is tracked separately.
ReviewStatus.title: ReviewStatus

SessionCreateRequest.description: Sign-in body. The only request body that may carry a persona (PRD §4.1).
SessionCreateRequest.title: SessionCreateRequest

SessionInfo.description: Current session. Carries the masked email, never the raw address.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

SourceCitation.description: Provenance for a knowledge record (PRD v2 §8.1).
SourceCitation.title: SourceCitation

StepStatusView.description: One planned step as persisted (decision, approval, execution reference).
StepStatusView.title: StepStatusView

ToolExecutionStatus.description: What actually happened at the tool server, as evidenced by its ledger.
ToolExecutionStatus.title: ToolExecutionStatus

ToolInvocationResult.description: What the tool server actually did. A plan or ALLOW is not proof of execution.

jti.description: Application-generated invocation ID (not an ArmorIQ claim)
jti.title: Jti

tool_server_reached.description: None when it cannot be determined
tool_server_reached.title: Tool Server Reached

ToolInvocationResult.title: ToolInvocationResult

ToolName.description:
Logical tool/action names from PRD v2 §6.

Exact registry representation must be confirmed by experiment E5.
ToolName.title: ToolName
